prompt: RimWorld painterly establishing-shot render, painterly vanilla-RimWorld art style: the underside of the Twilight Deep's living mold-mat roof, one continuous pale organism stretching shore to shore, seen from below in murky green water. Irregular gaps in the mat — skylights — let columns of hazy golden light stab down through the water, illuminating drifting motes of detritus and swaying bronze kelp forests beneath each shaft. Deep green gloom fills the spaces between the light columns. Elegant, glowing, otherworldly. No on-screen text, no UI elements, no logos.
